name: Menad Shisei
source:
Level/Level Cap: 33/46
Skill Level(s): Sword Combat LV1

Lieutenant general of the Leazas Red Corps and the youngest knight in the country.

Despite her age, she earned her position through sheer skill, and is one of the most talented sword fighters in all of Leazas.

A boyish girl who is sensitive about her lack of femininity, she is quite self-conscious for someone in her position. She is currently in a relationship with [url=/c55394]Zarak[/url], one of her subordinates, who she believes is the only person who sees her as a woman and not as a soldier. [spoiler]In reality, however, Zarak is manipulating her in order to abuse her power as lieutenant general.[/spoiler]

She is close friends with [url=/c52700]Kentou Kanami[/url], and the two often eat lunch together when off duty.
